Equipment Management

Track equipment calibration schedules and maintenance requirements.

equipment

Equipment calibration and maintenance API router.

This module provides JWT-authenticated endpoints for managing the calibration lifecycle of physical test equipment (ResourceNode ASSETs) and scheduling maintenance downtime windows.

Endpoints

  • POST /recalibrate — Record a completed calibration event, updating the equipment’s calibration dates and linking the certificate artifact.

  • POST /downtime-windows — Schedule a maintenance downtime window, marking the resource as out of service during the window.

  • GET /{resource_id}/calibration-status — Query the current calibration status of an equipment resource, including expiry countdown and active maintenance windows.

  • GET /{resource_id}/maintenance-windows — List all maintenance windows for a resource within a date range.

Access Control

All endpoints require a valid JWT token via the get_current_user dependency. The authenticated user must have sufficient clearance to access the target resource node.

Usage

# Record a calibration event
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/equipment/recalibrate       -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"       -H "Content-Type: application/json"       -d '{
"resource_id": "uuid",
"calibration_date": "2026-10-24",
"interval_days": 365
}'

# Schedule maintenance downtime
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/equipment/downtime-windows       -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"       -H "Content-Type: application/json"       -d '{
"resource_id": "uuid",
"downtime_start": "2026-11-01T08:00:00Z",
"downtime_end": "2026-11-03T17:00:00Z",
"maintenance_type": "SCHEDULED_RECALIBRATION",
"work_order_reference": "WO-2026-001",
"technician_name": "J. Smith"
}'

What You Can Do

Viewing Information

  • View: Query the current calibration status of an equipment resource.

  • View: List maintenance windows for a resource within a date range.

Creating New Items

  • Create: Record a completed calibration event for an equipment resource.

  • Create: Schedule a maintenance downtime window for a resource.
